description: Create a location board. The backend derives an English `prompt_prefix_en` from the fields you give — that prefix is what later anchors every image and clip shot there, so the richer the description, the more consistent the place. Pass project_id to bind the board to a project (recommended: unbound boards are invisible to lab_list_project_locations).

atmosphere.description: Mood, weather, sound of the place

description.description: What the place is, in prose

project_id.description: Bind the board to this project (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

project_name.description: Free-text project label shown in listings

name: lab_create_location
title: Create Location
